Pune. Notice period: 60 days.

Data Scientist, Ledgerly — Dec 2022 - Present
At Ledgerly I developed and deployed predictive models for transaction anomaly detection and customer churn scoring. Built end-to-end pipelines in Python3 using pandas for preprocessing and feature engineering, and scikit-learn for baseline models before handing over to MLOps. Implemented SQL-driven feature extraction from transactional warehouses and optimized queries to reduce ETL runtime by ~30%. Collaborated via Git and Confluence to version code and document experiments. Leveraged Linux servers for model training and batch scoring. Regularly produced dashboards and KPI reports tracking precision/recall and production inference latency.

Machine Learning Engineer, Kite Learning — Oct 2021 - Nov 2022
At Kite Learning I designed supervised ML solutions for learning-path personalization and content recommendation. Implemented data pipelines in Python3 with pandas for session rollups and feature aggregation, and trained models with scikit-learn. Wrote and tuned SQL queries to join behavioral and profile data, improving feature freshness and cutting query cost. Managed code in Git, documented design decisions in Confluence, and ran model training and validation on Linux-based instances. Delivered model performance improvements measured by AUC and uplift in engagement metrics.

Skills: Python3, ML, scikit-learn, pandas, SQL, Git, Confluence, Linux

Education: CA, ICAI
